description: Add or change the project's private objects, the values the simulated user personally holds, as the private objects section of System knowledge does. Each category is matched by name: a new name adds a category, rename_to renames one. Each item without an id is added (it needs a value); an item with an id changes that item, and left without a value it keeps the one it has. Categories and items you do not name are kept; delete_private_objects removes them. The reply lists names and ids only, never values: do not repeat a value back to the user.

description.description: What kind of value it holds; an empty text clears it.
description.title: Description

items.description: Items to add (no id) or change (by id). Items not named are kept.
items.title: Items

name.description: The category's name; a new name adds one.
name.title: Name

rename_to.description: A new name for the category.
rename_to.title: Rename To

description.description: What the item is; an empty text clears it.
description.title: Description

id.description: An existing item's id, as list_private_objects shows it; left out for a new item.
id.title: Id

value.description: The value: one text, or an object of named fields for one record. Needed for a new item; left out, an existing item keeps its value.
value.title: Value

categories.description: Categories to add or change. Categories not named are kept.
categories.title: Categories

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

name: set_private_objects
